_doc: Maps each Halmos check_* function to its property-test-generator bounds and any shrunk counterexamples from test.check. Generator source: sew-simulation/test/resolver_sim/contract_model/properties_test.clj

gen-amount.note: Clojure model has no decimals; Solidity ERC20Mock uses 18 decimals. Handler bound: [1e4, 1_000_000e18].

gen-bps.note: Fee basis points. FEE_BPS=100 in tests (1%), within range.

gen-time.note: Block time deltas in seconds. APPEAL_WINDOW=9999 to match upper bound.

gen-addr.note: Halmos check_custom_resolver_exclusivity generalises to svm.createAddress() covering all 2^160 addresses.

check_solvency_after_create.counterexample_shape: amount where fee arithmetic underflows or double-credit inflates held figure

check_fees_monotone_after_create.counterexample_shape: amount where FEE_BPS arithmetic rounds down to zero fee despite nonzero amount

seeds._note: Boundary seed: minimum amount where fee > 0 at 1% = 10000 / 100 = 100 wei fee

symbolic_inputs: attacker: address (function parameter — Halmos 0.3.x does not support vm.prank with svm.createAddress)
check_custom_resolver_exclusivity.counterexample_shape: attacker address that passes _isAuthorizedDisputeResolver despite not being customResolver

seeds._note: Boundary seed: zero address (excluded by vm.assume)
Boundary seed: address(1) — minimal non-excluded attacker

check_released_state_absorbing.assertion: raiseDispute on RELEASED escrow always reverts
check_released_state_absorbing.counterexample_shape: amount where releaseEscrowTransfer leaves state flag inconsistent

check_appeal_window_enforced.assertion: executePendingSettlement before appeal deadline always reverts
check_appeal_window_enforced.counterexample_shape: timeDelta where block.timestamp + timeDelta >= appealDeadline despite timeDelta < APPEAL_WINDOW

seeds._note: Boundary seed: timeDelta=1 (one second into window)
Boundary seed: timeDelta=9998 (one second before deadline)

notes: Always build with --profile halmos first (via_ir=false required)
Start with check_solvency_after_create — simplest, single createEscrow call
check_custom_resolver_exclusivity is the highest-value check (proves authority logic exhaustively)
Increase --loop if Halmos reports 'loop bound exceeded' warnings
If SMT solver times out, try --solver-timeout-branching 30000
